about_the_game:
Reel Run is a 3D arcade-style hack and slash that puts players in the lead roles of popular movie archetypes. In this action-packed game, players face off against hordes of enemies across multiple genre-themed levels, each styled to emulate the film’s era while keeping a fun, arcade-like energy. This blend of unique visual styles, intense combat, and familiar movie tropes brings a nostalgic yet fresh experience that makes players feel like true action heroes.

Unique Levels

Each level unique and puts you in a different film genre. Feel like the main character and fight through waves of enemies to accomplish your goal in each film as the main character!

Unique Characters

Each level has a unique playable character with varied combat abilities and moves to play any way you want!

Destructible Environments

Break things! Destruction is necessary to be a true action star! Break the enviroment in fun ways mid scene to get the best take possible.
